name: B10-0084/2024 (S&D) – The democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns two new Georgian laws: one on "foreign influence" and one on "family values and protection of minors". It says these laws go against European Union values and Georgia's wish to join the European Union. It asks Georgia to withdraw them, to stop attacking opposition parties and civil society, and to return to democratic reforms.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and asks Georgia to withdraw the two laws.
- The laws affect civil society groups, independent media, opposition parties and vulnerable people in Georgia.
- Next, Parliament sends its position to European Union institutions and to Georgia's president, government and parliament.
